The police ensured safety amid ongoing investigations into the threat. Sharing updates on his recovery journey from health issues, Bachchan emphasized the need for more rest while continuing to engage viewers as the host of 'Kaun Banega Crorepati.'

title: Woman found dead in Lucknow; note with 4 men’s names, 4-digit number found in bag
description: A 25-year-old woman, Asiya alias Tina, was found dead under suspicious circumstances near Kisan Path. Police have launched a murder investigation following the discovery of a handwritten note in her belongings. Asiya had left her sister's home in Unnao and failed to reach her destination, which led to concerns. Injury marks suggested possible strangulation before her body was dumped in Lucknow.

title: 1834 Métis house sold for $2, moved across Canadian bay to become museum
description: The historic Labatte House, a Métis residence from 1834, is set to be carefully moved to Balm Beach to ensure its preservation. Weighing approximately 75,000 pounds, the relocation is a meticulous endeavor across Georgian Bay. This effort seeks to create a museum dedicated to Indigenous and Métis narratives in the area, with restoration scheduled to start soon and a concrete foundation expected by spring 2027.

title: Canadian couple builds swimming pond for $52,000 after quotes hit $200,000
description: On their sprawling 65-acre property, Crystal Drinkwalter and Jazmyn Canning took on the ambitious project of building a natural swimming pond after being deterred by high contractor fees. Through hard work, they relocated more than 100,000 pounds of rock and lined the pond by hand. It took eight water trucks to fill their 110,000-gallon pond with water. For a detailed look at this impressive feat, visit their YouTube channel.

First Indian ever! Deepti Sharma scripts history with century against Zimbabwe
description: In a remarkable display of skill, Deepti Sharma secured her place in history with an unbeaten century against Zimbabwe in Vadodara. Achieving the milestone in just 83 balls, she struck 15 boundaries, demonstrating her batting prowess from the No. 6 position. Furthermore, Harmanpreet Kaur's impressive 126-run innings added fuel to the fire, as they forged a record partnership, propelling India to a formidable total.

title: US midterms: From immigration reform to $15 minimum wage, all about Pramila Jayapal
description: Pramila Jayapal is gearing up for her re-election campaign in Washington’s 7th Congressional District. She will compete against Republican Nirav Sheth, who prioritizes public safety and addresses homelessness issues. Jayapal champions healthcare, immigration reform, and tackling economic inequality. Notably, she broke barriers as the first South Asian American woman in Congress back in 2016. The election is slated for November 3, with both candidates actively promoting their visions.

title: Veterans seek court order to block Trump's 250-foot arch before Nov 5
description: US President Donald Trump's proposed 250-foot triumphal arch in Washington could begin construction as early as November 5, pending final approvals. However, three military veterans and a retired architectural historian have asked a federal judge to stop the work, arguing that congressional authorisation is required. The project faces two lawsuits questioning its approval process and legality.

title: 'If it was up to me': Anderson admits Lancashire exit was not how he wanted it to end
description: Anderson expressed his disappointment in a social media post, writing: "I've supported Lancashire since I was a kid and so to get to play for them for 25 years was a dream come true.

The election highlights divisions within the opposition and potential coalition challenges.

Kochi: 55-year-old man killed as judge’s minor son rams luxury car into scooter
description: A 55-year-old man named Jayabalakrishnan died after a luxury car collided with his scooter in Kochi. The minor driver, a 17-year-old, is the son of an Additional District Judge. The police have detained the teenager and registered a case for reckless driving and causing death by negligence. Initial investigations indicate that the minor was not under the influence of alcohol at the time of the incident.

title: BSF apprehends four Pakistani fishermen in Kutch, seizes boat
description: On Sunday, four Pakistani fishermen were intercepted by the Border Security Force in the Kutch district of Gujarat. Suspected of illegally fishing in Indian waters for crabs, they were detained following precise intelligence alerts. The crew members, hailing from Chach Jaan Khan village in Sindh province, are now under investigation as the BSF maintains vigilance over the sensitive border region to thwart unauthorized entries.

A stunning 60-foot cut-out of her has been unveiled at Vels Theatre, marking this momentous occasion in Tamil cinema. Co-star Regina Cassandra has lauded Nayanthara for her significant contribution.

title: Yuki Bhambri wins Almaty Open; triumph offers boost after medal-less Asiad
description: Bhambri and Seggerman won 7-6(3), 6-7(1), [10-2] to secure the ATP 250 title and give Bhambri his fifth career doubles crown on the ATP Tour.

title: A taste of crocodile in Thailand lands Madhya Pradesh civic officer in hot water
description: A video has emerged featuring Ujjain Municipal Corporation officer Rajkumar Rathore and his wife sampling crocodile meat during their trip to Thailand. Rathore was on leave from October 19 to 23 but failed to inform anyone about his overseas travel. Municipal Commissioner Abhilash Mishra stated that officials must obtain permission for international journeys. The situation will be examined, and disciplinary measures may follow if rules were breached.

title: Jaishankar takes swipe at ‘political calculations’ days after Rubio defends Pak ties
Deadlock thaws: IndiGo, AI Express to start int’l flights from Navi Mumbai from Dec
description: In an exciting move, IndiGo is set to launch international flights from Navi Mumbai International Airport in February 2027. The airline aims to shift twelve daily international departures from Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport to enhance travel connectivity. This strategic transition will also support the redevelopment of the existing airport.

title: ‘Nuclear threat will overshadow all’: Netanyahu’s Iran warning ahead of polls
description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has issued a stark warning about the looming Iranian nuclear threat. Analyst Yuval Blumberg emphasizes the urgency of the next two years for Israel to take decisive measures. He cautioned against letting internal political matters overshadow critical national security issues, especially with the parliamentary election approaching on October 27. Trump's support of Netanyahu further solidifies their alliance as essential in addressing Iran's ambitions.

title: India wants to become a global talent hub. What needs to change?
description: Returning professionals are just one part of a wider flow of talent. Indians are coming back after years abroad. Members of the diaspora are sharing specialist knowledge from where they are. International experts are arriving for a defined period to build skills and pass them on. The pull is increasingly professional. India now hosts 2,117 global capability centres employing 2.36 million people, according to the Nasscom-Zinnov GCC Landscape 2026.

Uniyal accused Mehndi of lip-syncing and alleged he was under the influence, igniting outrage among the music community who rallied behind Mehndi. Following the escalating dispute, Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami stepped in to mediate, while Mehndi has remained notably silent amid the uproar.

title: 'Can't use it to kill people': Musk admits restricting Starlink in Ukraine
Elvish Yadav home firing, 58 cases: Why STF wants Himanshu Bhau back
description: Gangster Himanshu Bhau has been detained in the US, which may assist Haryana Police in extraditing him. He faces 58 criminal cases linked to violent gang activities in Rohtak and surrounding areas. Bhau allegedly runs an organized crime network responsible for killings, extortion, and illegal activities. Haryana's Special Task Force arrested numerous members of his gang, indicating ongoing efforts to tackle organized crime.

title: Shaheen Afridi surpasses Akhtar, becomes fastest Pak pacer to reach ODI milestone
description: Bowling first, Shaheen dismissed England opener Tom Banton in the first over to claim his 150th wicket in the 50-over format. The 26-year-old became the second-fastest Pakistani bowler overall and the fastest Pakistani fast bowler to reach the landmark.

title: ‘To hide roll manipulation’: Cong questions EC over withholding ECINET details
'This is Sachin, this is Dravid': How Manvanth Kumar fell in love with cricket
description: Karnataka all-rounder is finding his feet in domestic cricket with batting, bowling and ability to deliver under pressure. From his father's love for Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid to the influence of Manish Pandey and coaches Yere Goud and Vinay Kumar, Manvanth reflects on his journey, ambitions, workload management and his love for anime.

title: A festival, a DJ and a complaint: What residents can legally do about noise
The guardians keeping watch on Kota’s kids
description: In Kota, residents are trained to recognize warning signs of emotional distress in students facing academic pressures. Community interventions such as the darwaze par dastak initiative have been established to provide timely support. Local authorities are engaging with students directly to build trust and offer help as needed. Counseling and wellness programs have been integrated to support mental health in coaching centers.

title: Nasa’s Isaacman shares Artemis IV update as SpaceX, Blue Origin plan Moon base
description: NASA administrator Jared Isaacman provided an update regarding the Artemis III lunar mission and upcoming docking exercises. The agency plans for significant interactions with Elon Musk's SpaceX and Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin next year. Docking practices will involve astronaut teams launching aboard NASA's Orion capsule from Cape Canaveral. Isaacman indicated that the competition has intensified due to historical precedents set by earlier space missions.

title: Hyd techie found dead after threatening to take her life during video call to boyfriend
description: Archana Chowdhury Malik, a 29-year-old software employee, was discovered dead by hanging in Hyderabad. The incident occurred in an apartment located in Chandra Nayak Thanda. Police received information about her death and quickly arrived at the scene. Authorities have registered a case and are investigating the circumstances of her passing.

title: Centre rushes 250 RAF personnel to Arunachal after protests over hydropower project
description: The Centre has deployed two Rapid Action Force companies comprising around 250 CRPF personnel to Arunachal Pradesh following violent protests against the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project. A mob torched an NHPC office and a police station in Pasighat, injuring over 40 police personnel. The project, seen as a strategic counter to China’s mega dam, faces opposition from indigenous tribes fearing displacement and submergence of villages.

title: Travis Kelce's $5.35 million estate faces opposition over landscaping plans
description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion faces fresh delays as neighbors challenge his landscaping and fencing plans. Residents have raised concerns about wildlife safety, lake views and potential damage to an aging sewer line, with one neighbor citing $75,000 in repair costs. Kelce’s construction team says it has spent $7,500 on sewer repairs and adjusted the plans. However, local officials require further changes before the remaining landscaping work can proceed.

title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany's KC Current extend unbeaten home run to 31 games
description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes’ Kansas City Current have secured their third consecutive NWSL playoff berth after Portland’s 1-0 win over North Carolina. The club now aims to secure home-field advantage ahead of the postseason. Despite roster changes, Kansas City has maintained a record 31-game unbeaten home streak. Temwa Chawinga leads the team with 12 goals, while Croix Bethune has recorded 10 assists heading into the decisive final matches.

title: What’s Delhi breathing? IITM’s new lab decodes air mix
description: Real-time data from the new Integrated Atmospheric Chemistry and Aerosol Toxicity Analysis Laboratory highlights various pollution contributors. Vehicles were the largest contributor to Delhi's PM2.5 pollution at 25%. Secondary organic and inorganic aerosols also significantly contributed to pollution levels across the city. This facility, inaugurated by Union minister Jitendra Singh, aims to identify and assess pollution sources.

title: Rocket founder Dan Gilbert forgoes profits on $2.2 billion Detroit redevelopment
description: Dan Gilbert has pledged a remarkable $1 billion towards the revitalization of the Renaissance Center and Detroit's east riverfront. By establishing a nonprofit, this investment is transformed into a philanthropic donation, prioritizing community well-being over profit. After covering initial costs, future revenues will support local initiatives and foster public spaces, aiming to breathe new life into the aging infrastructure while enriching the community's cultural landscape.
